Crates compiled into web_bg.wasm of Oxigraph 0.5.13, with their licence texts

web_bg.wasm is compiled Rust. These are the 107 crates that
  cargo tree --locked -p oxigraph-js --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -e normal,no-proc-macro
lists in the Oxigraph repository at tag v0.5.13 (Cargo.lock SHA-256 310850c9e15fb4ec8081e3aa6ac107b855cffe49ca257b47a63f04ff4d0580b9), with
the default features of oxigraph-js, which the npm package is built with. Build scripts,
procedural macros and the crates of other targets run or exist only while it is compiled and
are not part of it. Each line gives the crate, the licence expression its Cargo.toml states,
and the licence this distribution takes it under. The crates of the Oxigraph repository are
taken under MIT, whose text is LICENSE-MIT beside this file; a crate taken under Apache-2.0 has
the text LICENSE-APACHE beside this file (none of them ships a NOTICE file); for every other
crate its own licence file follows, with its copyright notice, once for the crates whose file
is the same text. Read on 2026-11-10 from the crate packages cargo fetched for that Cargo.lock.

Format: crate version | licence expression | taken under
